entries.name: 玻璃态二氧化硅 Model I
entries.phase: bulk vitreous silica; 3D cubic periodic model; 144 atoms

source.name: Materials Cloud Archive
source.conditions: 144-atom model generated by combined classical and first-principles molecular dynamics; cubic cell fixed to reproduce density 2.2 g/cm3; temperature and pressure not reported.
source.citation: L. Giacomazzi, P. Umari, and A. Pasquarello, Phys. Rev. B 79, 064202 (2009), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.79.064202.

normalization.method: pymatgen 2026.5.4 CifParser; full-cell expansion; explicit source-preserving normalization
details: Original XYZ atom coordinates are unchanged. Cell lengths and cubic/PBC evidence are preserved separately from the original coordinate file for existing pymatgen-based conversion; no atom coordinates were added or inferred.
Parsed with pymatgen 2026.5.4 CifParser from source.cif.
Expanded source crystallographic symmetry to the full stated unit cell with primitive=False; the source cell is preserved for 3D structures.
Checked formula and every atom site; mixed species or explicit fractional/unknown occupancy are rejected rather than ordered.
Mapped each expanded atom to its original CIF atom-site label and 1-based source row; normalized atom IDs are generated from the entry ID and row order.
P1 in source.cif is a format-conversion representation of the explicitly supplied cell and atoms, not a computed space-group assignment; no symmetry detection is claimed.
Disabled CifParser fractional-coordinate idealization (frac_tolerance=0) for this P1 format-converted source so the explicit source coordinates remain intact.

Retained source.xyz and original source-metadata files plus source-cell-evidence.txt/source-cell.json. The complete cubic three-dimensional periodic cell is taken from the cited publication and per-file archive README, never inferred from the coordinate bounding box. P1 is a file representation, not a crystal-symmetry claim.
